# About {.unnumbered}

Based at [New York University](https://www.nyu.edu/), Databrary is the world's only large-scale data repository specializing in storing and sharing research videos in behavioral sciences and the broader research community. It supports the storing, streaming, and sharing of video and audio recordings along with a wide range of research materials such as transcriptions, images, and metadata.
